$comment: ADR-479: dedicated sailboat art. The atlas has NO image file of its own: its pixels are painted at runtime by apps/client/src/task421-art.ts (software rasterizer -> blob URL, the Task 34 / ADR-361 pattern) and the sources override in view.ts points the registry at that blob URL, so the image/ktx2 paths below are never fetched. They point at a real pack atlas only because the pack test requires every manifest atlas to name a PNG + KTX2 twin that exist on disk. Vehicle layout: 4 cols x 6 rows of the def's frame (two rows per sail phase 0-2, Art order E,SE,S,SW,W,NW,N,NE in row-major order); frame(phase, dir) = phase*8 + dir, so the idle animation is frames [8] (full sail) and the sail animation cycles [0, 8, 16] at 4 fps (slack / full / billowing). resolveVehicleArt binds this by def id (sprite key == def id, first animation 8 directions, veh_art_* atlas = native scale). Frame 300x228 + anchor (0.5, 0.6623) come from boatFrameSize(SAILBOAT_ART) in the painter (asserted in apps/client/test/adr479_sailboat_art.test.ts).
